SELECT 'sales_rows' k, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) d, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) d2, min(sale_date) mn, max(sale_date) mx
FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-09-15' AND DATE '2025-11-02'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'ret_rows', count(*), count(DISTINCT return_line_id), count(DISTINCT sales_line_id), min(return_date), max(return_date)
FROM fact_return_line WHERE return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-09-22' AND DATE '2025-10-26'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'web_orders', count(*), count(DISTINCT web_order_id), 0, min(order_ts_utc), max(order_ts_utc) FROM fact_web_order WHERE order_ts_utc BETWEEN TIMESTAMP '2025-09-15' AND TIMESTAMP '2025-11-02'

WITH dups AS (
  SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM fact_sales_line
  WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-09-15' AND DATE '2025-11-02'
  GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1
)
SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sale_date, f.store_key, f.product_key, f.channel_code, f.quantity, f.net_amount, f.etl_loaded_at
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dups d USING (receipt_id, line_no)
ORDER BY f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sales_line_id LIMIT 12

WITH dups AS (
  SELECT receipt_id, line_no, count(*) c, count(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) e, count(DISTINCT net_amount) na, count(DISTINCT sale_date) sd
  FROM fact_sales_line
  WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-09-15' AND DATE '2025-11-02'
  GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1
)
SELECT c, e, na, sd, count(*) n FROM dups GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY n DESC

WITH web_dispatch AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
  FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
),
dedup AS (
  SELECT * FROM fact_sales_line
  QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY receipt_id, line_no ORDER BY sales_line_id) = 1
),
mk AS (
  SELECT 'dedup' v, COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) bd, f.net_amount n FROM dedup f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'raw', COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date), f.net_amount FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
),
agg AS (SELECT v, sum(n) s FROM mk WHERE bd BETWEEN DATE '2025-09-22' AND DATE '2025-10-26' GROUP BY v),
rp AS (SELECT sum(net_sales_before_returns) s FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-09-22' AND DATE '2025-10-26' AND store_id<>999)
SELECT v, s FROM agg UNION ALL SELECT 'rpt', s FROM rp

WITH web_dispatch AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
  FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
),
net_lines AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, p.sku, p.category AS cat_asof, f.net_amount AS net_sales, f.standard_cost AS cost
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
  WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT r.return_date, p.sku, p.category, -r.refund_net, -r.standard_cost_returned
  FROM fact_return_line r
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT cp.category AS as_is_category, d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period,
       ROUND(SUM(n.net_sales),2) AS net_sales, ROUND(SUM(n.net_sales - n.cost),2) AS gross_margin,
       ROUND(100.0*SUM(n.net_sales - n.cost)/SUM(n.net_sales),2) AS gm_pct,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN n.cat_asof=cp.category THEN n.net_sales ELSE 0 END),2) AS ns_aswas_same
FROM net_lines n
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = n.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period=6 AND cp.category IN ('Garden','Electrical')
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1

SELECT cp.category, d.fiscal_period,
  count(*) n, sum(CASE WHEN f.standard_cost IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) null_cost, sum(CASE WHEN f.standard_cost<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) zero_cost,
  sum(CASE WHEN f.net_amount<0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) neg_net,
  sum(CASE WHEN f.standard_cost > f.net_amount*1.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) hi_cost,
  ROUND(100.0*sum(f.net_amount-f.standard_cost)/sum(f.net_amount),2) gm_before_returns
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND cp.category IN ('Garden','Electrical')
  AND d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 4 AND 8
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2
